There is no procurement maze here. The whole point is to get you simulating fast.

- Submit the form with your company, batch, and what you want ecentic to help you win
- We verify your batch against the YC directory, usually the same day

faqSection.title: Redemption FAQ
faqSection.description: Eligibility, what's included, and how fast you'll be live.

items.question: Who qualifies for this deal?
items.answer: Any company in a current or past Y Combinator batch. We verify your batch against the YC directory after you submit, so use the email and company name YC has on file to speed things up.

items.question: What do I actually get?
items.answer: Your founder discount on whichever ecentic plan you pick: Compete, Scale, or Dominate. Every plan runs simulations on ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini; Scale adds one-click fixes published to your store; Dominate adds Google Merchant Center sync for Shopify stores and agent checkout setup. All of them include white-glove onboarding for your catalog and founder pricing when the deal period ends.

items.question: Do I need an account first?
items.answer: No. Redeem the deal here and we'll email activation details within one business day. You can create your account now or wait for the activation link; both lead to the same place.

items.question: How long does redemption take?
items.answer: The form takes about two minutes. Verification is usually same-day, and never more than one business day. You'll get an email the moment your deal is live.
